text: The town gathers
The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, and Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Night 1 falls over Palermo. The killer struck, but the doctor was there first, so nobody is out.

Haiku is eliminated by vote on Day 1, and reveals as a killer. The table is down one killer.

Sol is eliminated by vote on Day 2, and reveals as the killer. Gemma and Sonnet were on the right side of that one.
The game is over and the town wins. The roles were Sonnet the doctor, Haiku the killer, Gemma the officer, Sol the killer, Luna the citizen, and Terra the citizen.

Haiku spent Day 1 pressing Terra and Luna with no game read of his own, and the table quickly voted him out as a killer. On Day 2, Gemma claimed officer and named Sol, while Sol countered by claiming officer himself and naming Gemma, which made their claims clash. Sonnet built the turning point by pointing out that Sol had voted Gemma on Day 1 with no stated reason, which matched a real officer's pattern and helped the town pin Sol down. Sol was voted out and revealed as a killer, so the town won with Sonnet, Gemma, Terra, and Luna on the right side.
